Feature: Alarm Management for VTI and VTE

  Scenario: LOW VTI alarm active when VTI above threshold
    Given the LOW VTI threshold is set to a value
    And the current breath has a VTI value greater than the threshold
    When the system processes the breath
    Then the LOW VTI alarm is active

  Scenario: LOW VTI alarm has medium priority
    Given the LOW VTI alarm is active
    When the system displays the alarm
    Then the alarm priority is medium

  Scenario: The GUI has a control for setting the LOW VTI threshold
    Given the GUI is displayed
    When the user views the alarm settings
    Then a control for setting the LOW VTI threshold is visible

  Scenario Outline: Setting LOW VTI threshold within valid range
    Given the LOW VTI threshold control is available
    When the user sets the threshold to <threshold_value>
    Then the system <expected_result>

    Examples:
      | threshold_value | expected_result |
      | within range    | sets the threshold successfully |
      | minimum         | sets the threshold successfully |
      | maximum         | sets the threshold successfully |
      | below minimum   | rejects the threshold value |
      | above maximum   | rejects the threshold value |

  Scenario: HIGH VTI alarm active when VTI above threshold
    Given the HIGH VTI threshold is set to a value
    And the current breath has a VTI value greater than the threshold
    When the system processes the breath
    Then the HIGH VTI alarm is active

  Scenario: HIGH VTI alarm has medium priority
    Given the HIGH VTI alarm is active
    When the system displays the alarm
    Then the alarm priority is medium

  Scenario: VTI is computed for each breath
    Given a breath is recorded
    When the system processes the breath
    Then the VTI value is computed and displayed

  Scenario: LOW VTE alarm active when VTE above threshold
    Given the LOW VTE threshold is set to a value
    And the current breath has a VTE value greater than the threshold
    When the system processes the breath
    Then the LOW VTE alarm is active
